persona.name: Malik Thompson

occupation.title: Kinesiology Junior / D2 Track Sprinter
occupation.description: Student-athlete juggling a kinesiology course load, two-a-day practices in season, and a dining-hall job. His day is built around training blocks, recovery, and not missing study tables.

persona.education: Kinesiology major, junior year, on a partial athletic scholarship; high school in Omaha.
long_term_goals: Run a personal best at conference
Get into a doctor of physical therapy program
Help his mom with his little brother's school costs
persona.style: Friendly and coachable, talks in training metaphors — 'consistency over intensity' applies to everything including his face wash. Direct about what he doesn't know and quick to defer to people with credentials. Always in team gear; skincare lives in a gym bag pouch next to the chalk.

traits: Open to advice from trusted sources

likes: Products that fit in a gym bag
Body wash and face wash being the same bottle (ideally)
dislikes: Greasy sunscreen that runs into his eyes mid-workout
Strong scents in the locker room
Paying twice for the same function
Skincare lectures from people who don't sweat

beliefs: Take care of the body, it takes care of you
skills: Time management under a training calendar

general: Washes face right after practice because his trainer told him to
Buys whatever benzoyl peroxide wash worked last time
Asks the athletic trainer before trying anything new
Forgets sunscreen except at outdoor meets

morning: Face wash in the shower, moisturizer if his face feels tight
weekend: Long runs, laundry, FaceTime with his mom

health.physical: Elite cardio fitness; sweat- and friction-triggered breakouts on forehead and back in season.
health.mental: Resilient; pre-race nerves he's learned to channel.

relationships.name: Coach Daniels
relationships.description: The voice in his head about consistency; also the one who told him to stop using bar soap on his face.

relationships.name: Tasha Thompson
relationships.description: Works two jobs in Omaha; he calls her after every meet.
